name: rust-store
description: Website, kit store and game plugin for a Rust server.

scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm --prefix server ci && npm --prefix web ci
scripts.typecheck: wrangler types && npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix server run typecheck:worker && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.build:cloudflare: npm --prefix server install --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix web install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix server run cf:headers
scripts.build:node: npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix server run build
